name: Koi no Sweet Tart wa Ikaga?
original_name: 恋のスイートタルトはいかが?
source:
There is a coffee shop "Gerbera" on the bank of a beautiful lake in Tokyo. Cute girls are serving as waitresses and establishment is famous for its homemade cakes. Hero is a university student who works here part-time as a waiter. This summer will be most entertaining!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京一座美丽湖泊的岸边有一家名叫“非洲菊”的咖啡馆。可爱的女孩们在那里担任女服务员，店铺也因自制蛋糕而闻名。主角是这里兼职工作的大学生服务员。今年夏天一定会非常有趣！

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
